name: gh-project-sync
description: Reconcile a GitHub Project board against a task-agent unified tasks.yml. New Todo cards become pending tasks; Won't-Do and Done cards are dropped from yml; yml entries with pr_url move their card to In Review (falling back to In Progress if the board lacks an In Review column) and post the PR link — never to Done, that stays a human decision once the PR merges. Idempotent.
